additional_info.subject: Re: ID0432818-DC/Si-D/ES-[Y2/S3 300000004076] Connectivity Issue CRM:02919000006
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The customer router XF4 must be set wired with the follow data
IP 192.168.10.222
Mask 255.255.255.0
Gateway 192.168.10.1
When set the router with the companion set the password to admin01it is works then and I can do ping to the gateway from the router. But when restart the charger there are 2 issues it is freeze in 30% or if run the router cannot do ping to the gateway and set the password automatically with the value storage in SCB
I set a new router and tried out of the charger, it works with the setting for the customer and I can do ping to the gateway. Then connect the router to the charger and reboot it but its freeze and 30%. Set againg the router with the companion tool then the charger run well but router lost communication with the gateway.
The IP of OCPP is: 192.168.10.120
At priori discard a problem in cables because if I disconnect the cable connected in the wan port of the router and connect it directly to the ethernet port of my laptop I can do ping to the rest of devices in customer network. If connect my ethernet port directly to the Wan port of XF4 and ping to the charger IP 192.168.10.222 all packets are lost.
Please let me know when you'll be available in order to check the charger. Tomorrow morning will be good I could be there at 8:30 am but need your confirmation.
